emma-cs: Hey team — escalation from acct-4821. Checkout flow started failing ~09:58 after the deploy. Payments tool returns schema validation error (400) and overall checkout latency spikes. Customer impact: blocked checkouts. Can someone triage?

mike-se: Do you have the failing payload + tool response?

emma-cs: Pasting sanitized request/response we got from their logs:
```
REQUEST -> POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful payments assistant. When calling tools, output JSON for the tool args. Examples: {\"amount\": \"one hundred dollars\", \"currency\": \"USD\"}"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Charge $100 to card on file"}
  ],
  "functions": [{"name": "charge_card", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"amount": {"type": "number"}, "currency": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["amount", "currency"]}}],
  "function_call": "auto"
}

RESPONSE from LLM -> (function call)
{
  "name": "charge_card",
  "arguments": "{\"amount\": \"one hundred dollars\", \"currency\": \"usd\"}"
}

TOOL RESPONSE -> 400 schema_validation_error: "amount" is not a number
```

ingrid-runtime: Right away: system prompt + example in the sys content is humanizing the amount. The model is returning "amount" as a human string because an example in the system role includes that format. That contradicts the function schema which expects a number.

devon-ml: We saw this exact failure in staging last quarter when a fewshot example leaked formatting. Two quick checks: which model variant was routed? and is any prompt-template layering applied by the routing layer?

mike-se: Routing logs: redwood-chat-1-v1 (float32) on nvidia-a100 pool. No extra template layering for this customer (they use default).

sarah-support: Also FYI billing: our alert shows a jump of ~1.8k failed tool calls and ~0.5k retries in the last hour for that org. They were charged for tool invocation units despite failures — customer is upset.

emma-cs: Customer repro steps: 1) call /v1/chat/completions with that system message + function schema 2) watch the returned function arguments; sometimes amount is string 3) our charge endpoint rejects -> 400. Happens ~30% of requests.

ingrid-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: system role examples are shadowing the function docs. The model prefers the example formats over the function schema when deciding tokenization and output format. This is classical schema drift caused by conflicting spec in the system prompt.

devon-ml: Quick mitigations:
- Enable strict JSON enforcement on the model output layer (auto-sanitize numeric fields)
- Add a short post-processing validation step to coerce numeric-looking strings to numbers where safe
- Temporarily pin to the model variant that respects function schemas more strictly (rollout to customer)

mike-se: For immediate workaround I patched the routing to force `function_call` to use the embed-verified variant and added a tiny filter that tries to parse numbers out of strings before invoking the tool. Deploying now.

ops-bot: deploy: mike-se pushed hotfix branch `cs/charge-coerce-hotfix` and deployed to prod at 2024-09-18T10:05:12Z (job #7842) :white_check_mark:

emma-cs: After the hotfix deploy the customer reports success on a test checkout. Fail rate dropped from ~30% -> ~2%. Billing refunds requested by customer for failed attempts, info added to the ticket.

sarah-support: Ticket updated. Will open chargeback request for 1700 failed invocations.

ingrid-runtime: Next actions (assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime):
1) Eng-ML: Investigate why this model variant is more susceptible to example leakage vs schema adherence. Add tests that validate function schema respect when script/fewshot examples present.
2) Eng-Runtime: Add a model-agnostic output sanitation layer that can optionally coerce primitive types based on function json-schema (config flag per org).
3) Docs/CS: Warn customers that system examples can override function schema; provide best-practice templates.

devon-ml: I'll take ML task. Proposed short-term fix: update decode heuristics to prefer function schema tokens (e.g., enforce numeric tokens for number fields). Long-term: model fine-tune or prompting guidelines.

mike-se: I'll follow up with a PR that adds the coercion layer + a canary to a few orgs. Also adding a smoke test that runs sample system prompts + functions to check for type drift.

emma-cs: Thanks all — sending this thread to the customer escalation ticket. Please add any follow-ups here. :pray:
